description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProvider class, which implements an OAuth provider module for the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and saving OAuth provider configurations, access control, generating redirect URIs, and obtaining configuration arrays. It appears to extend a Basic class and interacts with global system variables and logs.
external_files: parent class file that defines Basic

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProvider
classes.description: Represents an OAuth provider configuration within SuiteCRM, handling access control, configuration details, and security restrictions.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth provider record, with access control for personal accounts.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the OAuth provider configuration, with access control checks.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to the personal account type of OAuth provider.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event when a non-authorized user attempts access.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, e.g., ACL

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Determines access permission for a given view based on user privileges and account type.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a list query with access restrictions for non-admin users.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Preserves write-only field values during save operations.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if the action is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is security-group based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is not allowed for certain views.

methods.name: getRedirectURI
methods.description: Builds a redirect URI based on site configuration.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the OAuth provider configuration parameters as an array.

methods.name: deserializeMapField
methods.description: Decodes JSON-encoded configuration fields.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string from the scope configuration.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns extra provider parameters as an array.

methods.name: getTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns token request options as an array.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns refresh token request options as an array.

methods.name: getAuthorizeUrlOptions
methods.description: Returns authorize URL options as an array.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for refresh token requests, defaults to 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: getTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for token requests, defaults to 'authorization_code'.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping name for access token, defaults to 'access_token'.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping name for refresh token, defaults to 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: getExpiresInMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping name for token expiration, defaults to 'expires_in'.

methods.name: getTokenTypeMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping name for token type, defaults to empty string.
